summary: Updated implementation plan reflecting user revisions: (1) HEAD request checking for application/pdf only, document npm run pdf & /print fallback; (2) Electric Editorial photo system with thin borders, viewfinder brackets, offset color blocks, optional halftone (no washi tape or polaroid frames); (3) Ref-based single rAF loop for velocity skew and card tilt with touch disabling and overflow-hidden wrappers; (4) Flexible regex ep4-01 / ep04-01 photo discovery, build warning for missing metadata, alt fallback to caption; (5) WebP compression & learner face blur documentation in README.
